purpose: Supply the stochastic-reward equivalence evidence missing from the deterministic Gate GB replay campaigns without consuming GPU resources.

scope.route_allocation: Programs alternate direct and recursive routes, yielding exactly balanced preregistered strata.
scope.reward_model: Terminal-dependent Bernoulli probability in [0.2, 0.8], with independent HMAC-derived full-suffix and sliced draws.

equivalence_contract.interval: Two independent Bernoulli-arm Hoeffding intervals combined by a union bound.
equivalence_contract.pass_rule: The overall and both route-level confidence intervals must lie strictly within their frozen symmetric margins.

interpretation.pass: The randomized dynamic replay engine has distribution-free stochastic-reward equivalence at the frozen overall and route-level margins.
interpretation.fail: Record the failure without retrying or changing the frozen margins.
not_claimed: Gate GB clearance by this component alone
